name: coa-mapper
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-10-31. A 12-second MultipleNegativesRankingLoss fine-tune of BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 on 1,025 synthetic (source account -> target account) pairs, for chart-of-accounts migration between QuickBooks Desktop/Sage 50 and QuickBooks Online. Wins acc@1 0.883 vs 0.796 zero-shot, acc@5 0.964 vs 0.956, MRR 0.924 vs 0.868, on 137 mappings from 4 held-out companies. The card is unusually honest about the ceiling: a char-ngram TF-IDF baseline already reaches 0.745 acc@1 and the account names carry strong lexical signal, so the fine-tune's real gain is in the hard quarter (abbreviations, near-duplicates, type/detail-type disambiguation). Synthetic benchmark, one author, no adjudicated subset yet. Licence Apache-2.0, repo created 2026-08-24. Confidence 0.5.

benchmarks.name: COA-Map-Bench v1 acc@1
benchmarks.config: Card 'Results - COA-Map-Bench v1' table, row 'bge-small-en-v1.5 zero-shot' 0.796 vs row 'coa-mapper v1 (this model)' 0.883. Test split of gyaanbyte/coa-mapping-synthetic: 137 mappings from 4 held-out companies; candidates are the target accounts of the same company. Base is a ROW, not a column. Card also prints a TF-IDF char 2-4-gram cosine baseline at 0.745 acc@1 / 0.824 MRR - not recorded as a row because it is not a model score, but it is the honest floor on this synthetic, lexically-saturated task.
